description: Defines the Overlay class for handling virtual display overlay processing, including thread management, EGL context setup, frame processing, and rendering support within the Android framework.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Handles overlay rendering for screen recording, managing EGL context, frame processing, and thread lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates a thread for overlay processing and returns a BufferQueue producer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the overlay thread and releases resources.

methods.name: drawInfoPage
methods.description: Draws an informational page on the output surface.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new frame is available from the GLConsumer.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop of the overlay thread.

methods.name: setup_l
methods.description: Performs one-time setup on the overlay thread.

methods.name: release_l
methods.description: Releases all resources held by the overlay.

methods.name: eglRelease_l
methods.description: Releases EGL display, context, and surface.

methods.name: processFrame_l
methods.description: Processes a received frame from the virtual display.

methods.name: getTimeString_l
methods.description: Converts a monotonic timestamp into a human-readable string.
